how_NASHA_could_fail: The first dishes do not hold or taste like themselves
early_warning_signal: Failure codes on Session 1 plates; crispness below the frozen gate at T+10

how_NASHA_could_fail: The name cannot be used and the brand work was name-dependent
early_warning_signal: Counsel advises changing the name; any name-dependent purchase made early
cheapest_check: Keep all work brand-independent; hold name-dependent spend (D-79)

how_NASHA_could_fail: Real food cost and labor leave no contribution at any plausible price
early_warning_signal: Food cost layer close to or above any price headroom; high labor minutes per portion
Strong stated interest and weak behavior at the first paid or ticketed test
cheapest_check: Keep intent and behavior separate; test with strangers

early_warning_signal: Capacity warning in the model; ticket times well above target in a pilot
cheapest_check: Measured ticket times; the capacity warning in fin_model

how_NASHA_could_fail: The brewery consumes capital before beer demand is shown
early_warning_signal: Brewhouse quotes requested before a host or collaboration pilot has run

how_NASHA_could_fail: The founder cannot cover culinary, brewing and operations alone
early_warning_signal: No partner or chef joins; the founder is the only cook and operator at every test
cheapest_check: Early partner conversations once there is something real to show

how_NASHA_could_fail: The legal structure for beer with food does not allow the intended format
early_warning_signal: An alcohol attorney rules out the residency or brewpub route
cheapest_check: Scoped attorney questions when funds exist
